How It All Began

Our Story

Khloe and Patryk's story began in the spring of 2019 at the University of San Francisco, where they met in a Japanese conversation class. It was there that Patryk asked Khloe out on her very first date, a sunny afternoon in Japantown filled with sushi, laughter, and the magic of the cherry blossom festival.

One unforgettable moment from that day? When Khloe shared that her celebrity crush was Captain America, only for a stranger to stop Patryk moments later and tell him he looked just like him. From the very beginning, their connection felt a little serendipitous.

Life took them in different directions soon after, with Patryk transferring to LSU and the two going their separate ways, but they never fully lost touch.

Years later, in October 2024, Patryk reached out while visiting Atlanta, where Khloe is from, to see if she'd like to reconnect. That meeting became their "second first date," and from that moment on, they were inseparable.

Since reuniting, Khloe and Patryk have built a love that spans cities, countries, and continents. From Puerto Rico to Poland, road trips through the Northeast, and exploring Italy together, they've created a life full of adventure, family, and shared experiences. Khloe has since visited Poland multiple times, growing close with Patryk's family, while Patryk has become deeply connected with hers.

In November 2025, their journey came full circle. Back in San Francisco, where it all began, Patryk proposed to Khloe at the Golden Gate Bridge. And now, surrounded by love, memories, and the journey that brought them here, they're excited to begin their next chapter together.

Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I bring a plus one? +

Plus ones are welcome if indicated on your invitation. Please note it on your RSVP form. If you're unsure, don't hesitate to reach out to us directly!

Are children invited? +

We have chosen to keep our celebration intimate and primarily for adults, and we hope you can join us for a relaxed evening.

What is the dress code? +

See the Vibe section for dress code instructions.

What time should I arrive? +

We recommend arriving 15–20 minutes before the ceremony start time of 12:30 PM to allow time for parking and seating. The ceremony will begin promptly!

Is parking available at the venue? +

Yes! Parking is available at Pristine Chapel Lakeside. More details on overflow parking will be shared closer to the date if needed.

Where should I send my well wishes? +

We'd love to hear from you! Feel free to use the notes section of the RSVP form, or reach out to us personally. We treasure every kind word.
